themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, conduct interviews, or analyze data with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and refactor code, including their capabilities and risks.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that aid in the design process, from generating initial concepts to refining user interfaces and user experiences.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts, research papers, or earnings calls, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications used to create, distribute, analyze, and optimize surveys, including generating insights from survey data.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Covers AI's role in analyzing customer feedback, social media posts, and other text-based data to gauge sentiment and identify key themes.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles about how AI is being used to inform product strategy, roadmapping, feature prioritization, and user story generation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to generate synthetic data or simulate user interactions for testing, research, or training purposes.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and methodologies used to automate or enhance the process of testing user interfaces and product usability.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
